Agenda #1: Approval of Annual Report and Financial Statements - Approved the annual report and audited financial statements for fiscal year 2025, granting full discharge to directors and commissioners, with 99.75% shareholder approval.
Agenda #2: Approval of Net Profit Utilization - Allocated US$489.8 million net profit: US$1 million to mandatory reserve, US$8.5 million cash dividend with recording date 7 July 2026, and US$480.3 million to retained earnings; approved with 99.914% for, 0.012% against, and 0.074% abstain.
Agenda #3: Appointment of Public Accountant - Approved appointment of KAP Liana Ramon Xenia & Rekan (Deloitte) to audit fiscal year 2026 financial statements, with authority to the Board of Directors to determine honorarium; votes were 99.681% for, 0.244% against, and 0.075% abstain.
Agenda #4: Restatement of Article 3 of the Articles of Association - Approved revision of Article 3 to align with KBLI 2025, authorizing directors to execute the changes; votes were 95.522% for, 4.395% against, and 0.083% abstain.
Agenda #5: Report on Realization of Bond Proceeds - This item was informational only and did not require shareholder approval; it was presented without a binding vote.
